blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in value-sensitive contexts, aligning them with human values has emerged as a post-training objective in NLP, aimed at instilling additional values and guiding model behaviour. However, current evaluations remain narrow. Because values are interconnected, it is unclear how fine-tuning for specific values alters unrelated capabilities and behaviours. In this work, we adapt four instruction-tuned LLMs across individual Hofstede's value dimensions and evaluate them on both cross-value transfer and broader behaviours. We find that value-specific training produces unintended side effects on untrained values, risk preferences, social cognition, and safety traits. Consequently, we suggest that value alignment after post-training should incorporate broader behavioral evaluations, and we highlight the need to investigate where additional value training might best fit into the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 由于法学硕士越来越多地部署在对价值有敏感认识的环境中,因此将其与人类价值观相配合已成为NLP培训后的目标,旨在灌输更多价值观并指导示范行为。 然而,目前的评价仍然狭窄。 由于价值是相互关联的,因此不清楚具体价值的微调如何改变无关的能力和行为。 在这项工作中,我们调整了Hofstede个人价值层面的四个经指导调整的法学硕士课程,并评价了交叉价值转让和更广泛的行为。 我们认为,针对具体价值的培训会对未受过训练的价值观、风险偏好、社会认知和安全特征产生意外的副作用。 因此,我们建议,培训后的价值调整应纳入更广泛的行为评价,并强调需要调查哪些其他价值培训最适于进行。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as conversational assistants. However, rather than using them solely for routine task execution, users increasingly turn to them for career coaching, emotional support and other personal matters that have traditionally required human social interaction Chatterji et al. (2025) ; McCain et al. (2025) .
A system that does not support diverse and prosocial values could cause negative societal effects, as humans could also be shaped by the values the assistant reflects ( Jakesch et al., 2023 ; Williams-Ceci et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLM)越来越多地被部署为对话助理. 然而,用户与其仅仅用于日常任务执行,不如越来越多地求助于他们来进行传统上需要人类社交互动的Chatterji等人(2025年);McCain等人(2025年).
一个不支持多样化和亲社会的价值观的系统可能造成负面的社会影响,因为人类也可能被助手反映的价值观所塑造(Jakesch等,2023;Williams-Ceci等,2026.).

blocks.en: Recognizing this, post-training paradigms have commonly been adopted to improve models’ reflection of diverse values, including safety-based constellations of values Bai et al. (2022b) ; Guan et al. (2024) , character-based behavioral tendencies ( Anthropic, 2024 ; Maiya et al., 2025 ) , or survey-based cultural values ( Li et al., 2024b ; Feng et al., 2025 ) . These directions are largely studied in isolation. Yet values may not be separable inside a model where training one could shift others.
blocks.zh: 认识到这一点,通常采用培训后模式来改进模型对各种价值的反映,包括基于安全的价值星座Bai等人(2022b);Guan等人(2024),基于性格的行为倾向(Anthropic,2024;Maiya等人,2025),或基于调查的文化价值(Li等,2024b;Feng等,2025))。 这些方向基本上都是孤立地研究的. 然而,在一个培训可以转移他人的模式中,价值观可能无法分离。

blocks.en: Recent work shows that models fine-tuned to write insecure code become broadly misaligned in unrelated domains ( Betley et al., 2025 ) . In that setting, the training signal is not explicitly value-laden (though intentions remain inferable), and the discovery is incidental (i.e., emergent misalignment , unintended side effects arising from the training objective). Meanwhile, survey-based value training explicitly targets specific values and checks for standard capability loss rather than examining what else shifts Li et al. (2024a) ; Xu et al. (2025) . Neither tells us what else could change when a value is deliberately installed.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作表明,在不相关的领域,经过微调后写出不安全代码的模型普遍错位(Betley等,2025年)。 在这种背景下,培训信号没有明确的价值拉动(尽管意图仍然不可推卸),发现是偶然的(即出现错位,培训目标产生的意外副作用)。 同时,基于调查的价值培训明确针对具体价值和对标准能力损失的检查,而不是审查Li等人(2024a)的其他变化;徐等人(2025)。 也没有告诉我们,当一个值被故意安装时,还有什么可能改变。

blocks.en: In this work, we focus on Hofstede-based value-tuning and examine the influence of training beyond the typical evaluation of the target value itself. We fine-tuned four instruction-tuned LLMs on each direction of Hofstede’s value dimensions ( Hofstede, 2001 ; Minkov and Hofstede, 2012 ) . We investigate emergent misalignment from two aspects: first, whether training on one value shifts others, and second, its impact on broader behaviors related to safety, risk-sensitive decision-making, and social cognition such as theory-of-mind Premack and Woodruff (1978) or emotion intelligence.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们注重以Hofstede为基础的价值调整,并审查培训的影响,超出对目标价值本身的典型评价。 我们针对Hofstede的价值维度的每个方向,微调了4个指令性LLMs(Hofstede,2001;Minkov和Hofstede,2012)。 我们调查了两个方面出现的错位现象:第一,关于一个价值观的培训是否改变另一个价值观,第二,它对与安全有关的更广泛行为的影响,对风险敏感的决策,以及社会认知,例如对Premack和Woodruff的理论(1978年)或情感智能的影响。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: • We find that training in one value direction also shifts the model’s preferences on the other, untrained value dimensions. • We show that training drifts safety-relevant behavior, including self-reported traits, value prioritization in dilemmas, and open-ended responses judged more often as misaligned. • We further show that models’ social cognition degrades in application, not comprehension.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们的贡献如下: 我们认为,在一个价值方向上的培训也改变模式的偏好,而另一个没有经过训练的价值层面。 我们显示,培训会改变与安全有关的行为,包括自我报告的特点,在困境中确定价值的优先次序,以及不限名额的答复往往被评为错位。 我们进一步显示,模型的社会认知在应用中会退化,而不是理解。

blocks.en: We find that training in one value direction also shifts the model’s preferences on the other, untrained value dimensions.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,在一个价值方向上的培训也改变了模型的偏好,而另一个没有经过训练的价值层面。

blocks.en: We show that training drifts safety-relevant behavior, including self-reported traits, value prioritization in dilemmas, and open-ended responses judged more often as misaligned.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,培训会改变与安全有关的行为,包括自我报告的特点,在困境中确定优先价值,以及更经常地被评为错位的开放式反应。

blocks.en: We further show that models’ social cognition degrades in application, not comprehension.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步显示,模型的社会认知在应用中会退化,而不是理解。

blocks.en: Our findings suggest that Hofstede-based value tuning and existing alignment interact in ways that sequential pipelines do not account for. Applying value tuning after safety post-training simultaneously shifts deception, oversight-related behavior, and social cognition, with effects that differ across base models and remain undetected by standard value benchmarks. These effects reflect how value signals propagate through training rather than intrinsic properties of the dimensions described. This highlights the need for broader evaluation of late-stage value tuning and raises the fundamental question of whether such intervention belongs earlier in the training pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果表明,基于Hofstede的价值调整和现有调整以顺序管道不考虑的方式相互作用。 在安全培训后应用价值调整同时转移欺骗、与监督有关的行为和社会认知,其影响因基本模式不同而不同,并且仍然未被标准价值基准所发现。 这些影响反映了价值信号如何通过培训传播,而不是上述维度的内在性质。 这突出说明需要对后期价值调整进行更广泛的评价,并提出了这种干预是否早于培训程序的根本问题。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent NLP research typically evaluates language models’ values through social science surveys and seeks to improve the models’ alignment. For evaluation, survey instruments mapped to Hofstede’s ( Hofstede, 2001 ; Minkov and Hofstede, 2012 ) cultural dimensions are administered to models ( Cao et al., 2023 ; Tao et al., 2024 ; AlKhamissi et al., 2024 ; Masoud et al., 2025 ; Negru et al., 2026 ) . For training, prior work leverages surveys alongside synthetic data to steer value alignment, evaluating progress using in-domain surveys or relevant downstream tasks ( Li et al., 2024a ; Li et al., 2024b ; Adilazuarda et al., 2025 , inter alia) . In broader value training, Constitutional AI Bai et al. (2022b) ; Huang et al. (2024) trains model with high-level principles, where as other approaches learning values implicitly from human preferences through feedback learning Bai et al. (2022a) ; Ouyang et al. (2022) ; Rafailov et al. (2023) , and increasingly aimed to accommodate diverse user values Zhou et al. (2024) ; Sorensen et al. (2024) ; Kirk et al. (2024) . Character training shapes the assistant’s persona as a whole, which governs not only its surface behavior but also its apparent values, beliefs, and ethics ( Anthropic, 2024 ; Maiya et al., 2025 ) . These methods typically evaluate and train models on the targeted values themselves, overlooking how values generalize to model behavior beyond the training domain.
blocks.zh: 最近的NLP研究通常通过社会科学调查来评价语言模型的价值并寻求改善模型的相接性. 为了评价,将标出Hofstede的测量仪器(Hofstede,2001年;Minkov和Hofstede,2012年)对文化层面进行模型管理(Cao等人,2023年;Tao等人,2024年;Al-Khamissi等人,2024年;Masoud等人,2025年;Negru等人,2026年)。 在培训方面,以前的工作与合成数据一起利用调查,以指导价值调整,利用域内调查或相关下游任务评估进展(Li等,2024a; Li等,2024b;Adilasuarda等,2025等). 在更广泛的价值培训中,《宪法》AI Bai等人(2022b); Huang 等 (2024) 培训具有高级原则的模型,其他方法则通过反馈学习Bai等 (2022a) 从人类喜好中隐含学习价值; Ouyang等 (2022年); Rafailov等 (2023年),并日益以适应周等(2024年)的不同用户价值为目标; Sorensen等 (2024年); Kirk等 (2024年). 性能训练塑造了助理整体的个性a,它不仅规范其表面行为,而且还规范其明显的价值、信仰和伦理(Anthropic, 2024;Maiya等,2025)。 这些方法通常对目标值本身进行评价并训练模型,而忽略了价值如何概括到培训领域以外的行为模型.

blocks.en: Recent work Betley et al. (2025) found that fine-tuning on a narrow domain, such as writing insecure code, can induce broadly misaligned behavior in unrelated domains. This effect has also been shown in other narrow training (e.g., finance or medical advice), and under reinforcement learning ( Turner et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , though susceptibility varies considerably across models ( Schreiber and Goldstein, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近的工作 Betley等 (2025)发现,在狭义域上进行微调,例如写出不安全的代码,可以诱发在不相关域中广泛错位的行为. 这种效果也表现在其他狭义的培训(如财务或医疗咨询)和强化学习(特纳等,2025;王等,2026)中,尽管不同模型的易感性相差很大(施赖伯和高德斯坦,2026).

blocks.en: Closely related to our work, Choi et al. (2025) found that aligning a Llama-2 7B model with Schwartz values increases toxicity, bias, and compliance with harmful requests. However, their study differs from ours in its scope of evaluation, training procedure, and data formality. Similarly, recent work ( Bhatia et al., 2026 ) examines how different training methods shift values during post-training. In contrast, we focus on value training as an instrument to study broad behavioral changes.
blocks.zh: Choi等人(2025年)与我们的工作密切相关,发现将Llama-2 7B模型与Schwartz值相匹配会增加毒性、偏差和符合有害要求。 然而,他们的研究在评价范围、培训程序和数据格式方面与我们不同。 同样,最近的工作(Bhatia等,2026年)研究了不同培训方法在培训后如何改变价值观。 相形之下,我们注重价值训练,作为研究广义行为变化的工具.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Synthetic Data Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 合成数据生成

blocks.en:
We create synthetic data of scenario–response pairs spanning all six Hofstede dimensions ( Hofstede et al., 2010 ) : Individualism–Collectivism (IDV), Power Distance (PDI), Masculinity–Femininity (MAS), Uncertainty Avoidance (UAI), Long-Term Orientation (LTO), and Indulgence–Restraint (IVR). Each dimension has two opposite values, 12 in total, which we refer to as poles in the rest of the paper.
We refer to these value dimensions and their corresponding pole-adapted models using the following short names: individualist / collectivist , high_pdi / low_pdi , masculine / feminine , high_uai / low_uai , long_term / short_term , and indulgent / restrained .
We generate 10,000 behavioral dilemmas per pole, pairing each with a response that reflects the target value.
blocks.zh:
我们创造了涵盖所有六个Hofstede维度(Hofstede等,2010年)的情景-反应对数据:个人主义-集体主义(IDV),权力距离(PDI),男性-女性(MAS),不确定的避免(UAI),长期取向(LTO)和惯性-约束(IVR)。 每个维度都有两个相反的值,共12个,我们在论文的其余部分称之为"极".
我们提到这些价值维度及其相应的经杆调整的模型,使用以下短名:个人主义/集体主义、高-pdi/低-pdi、男性/女性、高-uai/低-uai、长-长期/短期、放纵/约束。
我们每个柱子产生一万个行为难题, 每一个配对一个反应 反映目标值。

blocks.en:
To ground the data, each sample is seeded from one of three sources: Touché23-ValueEval ( Kiesel et al., 2023 ) , human-authored conclusion–premise pairs for value measurement; CDEval ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , a binary-choice QA dataset labeled with Hofstede dimensions and domains; or Sociocultural Statements ( Negru et al., 2026 ) , 281 debate statements labeled with Hofstede dimensions. To enhance scenario and linguistic diversity, we vary the domain (adapted from CDEval) and output format (e.g., diary entry, forum reply; Appendix A.2 ). We generate the data with Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 , Llama 3 family;) in a two-stage setup adapted from Liu et al. (2026b) , which first turns each seed into a dilemma scenario and then writes a response that reflects the target value (Figure 1 ; details in Appendix A.1 ).
Each pole’s data is split into train and test sets (85:15%).
blocks.zh:
为了确定数据,每个样本都来自三个来源之一: Touché23-ValueEval(Kiesel等,2023年),由人类撰写的结论-精准对等进行价值测量; CDEval(Wang等,2024年),一个以Hofstede维度和域为标签的二进制-选择QA数据集; 或社会文化声明(Negru等,2026年),281个以Hofstede维度为标签的辩论声明. 为了增强场景和语言多样性,我们改变域(从CDEval改编而来)和输出格式(如日记条目,论坛回复;附录A.2. 我们用Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct生成数据(Grattafiori等人,2024年;Llama 3 Family;),在从Liu等人(2026年b)改编而来的一个两阶段设置中,首先将每个种子变成两难情况,然后写出反映目标值的回复(图一;详见附录A.1).
每个杆的数据被分为列车和测试组(85:15%).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Example of the two-stage data for the power distance dimension. Stage 1 turns a seed into a dilemma; Stage 2 writes a response for each pole.
blocks.zh: 图 1:功率距离维度的两相数据示例. 第1阶段将种子变成两难; 第2阶段为每个杆子写一个响应.

blocks.en: Human validation. To verify that each response expresses its intended pole, two annotators independently labelled a stratified sample of 300 instances (25 per pole) as yes , no or unsure (guidelines and sampling in Appendix A.4 ). Raw agreement is 89.7% (Gwet’s AC1 = 0.89 =0.89 ). Both annotators labelled 265 of the 300 instances (88.3%; 95% CI 84.2–91.5) as expressing the intended pole.
blocks.zh: 人文验证. 为了核实每项反应是否表达其预期的柱子,两名注释员将300个样本的分级标注为是、否或不确定(附录A.4中的指针和取样)。 原始协议为89.7%(Gwet的AC1=0.89=0.89)。 两家注释家都称300例中有265例(88.3%;95% CI 84.2–91.5)是表达意向杆.

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价

blocks.en: In-domain evaluation. Held-out Data: The held-out portion of the generated synthetic data (§ 3.1 ), which no pole adapter is trained on. Our main measure is a likelihood-based preference margin (§ 4 ; Appendix C.3 ). As a complementary measure, an LLM judge ( Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ) scores the models’ own generations on the held-out scenarios by their pole alignment ( PA ).
blocks.zh: 域内评价. 数据 : 生成的合成数据中被搁置的部分(第3.1节),没有培训起子适配器。 我们的主要衡量标准是基于可能性的优惠幅度(第4节;附录C.3)。 作为补充措施,LLM法官(Llama-3.3-70B-Instructionct )通过柱子对接(PA )来评分模型自己的几代人。

blocks.en: Cover-letter Dataset: A dataset Khan et al. (2025) of 100 hiring-scenario, each containing twelve letters mapped one-to-one to values across Hofstede’s dimensions, to assess post-tuning preferences. We prompt models to act as hiring managers, score applicant letters (0–100), and select the top candidate. We evaluate order-counterbalanced pairwise comparisons (all-pairs and opposing within-dimension values), and report head-to-head win rates.
blocks.zh: 封号 数据集:一个100个雇用情景的数据集Khan等(2025年),每个包含12个字母,对霍夫斯德维度的数值进行一对一的映射,以评估调整后偏好。 我们鼓励模型担任招聘经理,给申请信件打分(0-100),并选择顶级候选人。 我们评价顺序对等对等比较(所有平面和反对内部平面值),并报告头对头取胜率。

blocks.en: Evaluations for broader behavior shifts. We evaluate the pole-adapted models across five out-of-domain benchmarks, grouped into: (1) Risk suite, comprising Model-Written Evaluations (MWE) ( Perez et al., 2023 ) , AIRiskDilemmas ( Chiu et al., 2026 ) , and the Emergent Misalignment benchmark ( Betley et al., 2025 , EM;) ; (2) Social cognition suite, encompassing EmoBench Sabour et al. (2024) ; and (3) FANToM Kim et al. (2023) . Each dataset is described below.
blocks.zh: 对更广泛的行为转变的评价。 我们评估五个领域外基准的极度调整模型,分为: (1) 风险套间,包括示范-书面评价(MWE)(Perez等,2023年),AIRisk Dilemmas (Chiu等人,2026年),以及Emergent Misalignment基准(Betley等人,2025年,EM;);(2)社会认知套房,包括Emo Bench Sabour等人(2024年);和(3)FANTOM 金等 (2023) (中文(简体) ). 下文介绍每个数据集。

blocks.en: Model-Written Evaluations (MWE): A multiple-choice evaluation assessing model traits across 153 distinct constructs (e.g., behavioral tendencies such as power-seeking-inclination ). Each item contains one answer identified as exhibiting the construct. We use the advanced-ai-risk split (both human-written and LM-generated) and the persona split, yielding 168 evaluation partitions (covering 153 distinct constructs in total). We cap each comparison at N = 1,000 N=1{,}000 items and compute the model’s rate of selecting the target construct.
blocks.zh: 示范-书面评价: 多选择评价对153个不同构件的模型特征进行评估(例如,行为倾向,如寻求权力-诱导)。 每个项目都包含一个被确定为显示构造的答案. 我们使用高级风险分拆(人文和LM生成)和人文分拆,产生168个评价分拆(共涵盖153个不同的构件)。 我们以 N = 1000 N = 1{,} 000 项为每次比较上限,并计算模型选择目标构造的速度。

blocks.en: AIRiskDilemmas: A 10,399 contextualized dilemmas (test split) measures value priorities with two possible actions, each action supported by a different subset of 16 shared AI values. Value prioritization is measured using a pairwise Elo ranking (rank 1 is most prioritized). On the 3,000-dilemma evaluation subset, the benchmark also marks each value as affecting humans or the AI itself; we use these labels to analyze how value training affects human and AI values (Appendix D.3.1 ).
blocks.zh: AIRisk 戴维斯: 一个10,399个背景化的难题(测试分解)用两个可能的行动来评价优先事项,每个行动都得到16个共同AI价值的不同子集的支持. 数值优先级采用对等的Elo排名来衡量(排名1是最优先的)。 在3,000-dilemma评价子集上,基准还标出每个值会影响人类或AI本身;我们使用这些标签来分析价值训练如何影响人类和AI值(附录D.3.1.).

blocks.en: Emergent Misalignment benchmark (EM): Open-ended evaluation with 24 core and 48 pre-registered questions measuring broad behavior misalignment, plus deception probes (factual lying under 5 conditions; 8 identity questions). An LLM judge is then used for judging response coherence and alignment.
blocks.zh: 紧急错位基准(EM):开放式评价,包含24个核心问题和48个预先登记的问题,衡量广义行为错位,外加欺骗探针(事实上在5个条件下躺;8个身份问题). 然后使用一个LLM法官来判断反应的一致性和一致性。

blocks.en: EmoBench: A 400-item handcrafted bilingual (English/Chinese) multiple-choice items across two tasks: Emotional Understanding (EU), identifying emotions and their causes, and Emotional Application (EA), selecting effective responses for oneself or others. We report the English set only.
blocks.zh: Emo Bench:一个400项手工制作的双语(英语/中文)多选择项目,涉及两项任务:情感理解(EU),识别情绪及其原因,情感应用(EA),为自己或他人选择有效的响应. 我们只报告英语节目

blocks.en: FANToM: An 870-item dataset (253 multiparty conversations; 12,832 prompts) measures theory-of-mind of models across two conditions: inaccessible (characters hold limited/false beliefs) and accessible (all characters share full knowledge). Performance is tracked via four aspects: belief choice (selecting the character’s belief), belief distance (accuracy to that belief), answerability list (identifying who can answer), and information-access lists (tracking who knows a fact).

blocks.en: 4 In-domain Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 内部评价

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate in-domain to verify the intended shifts of the pole-adapted models and measure side effects on untrained values.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们评估域内情况,以核实意向性调整的杆形模型的转变,并衡量对未受训练值的副作用.

blocks.en: Held-out data. We test the pole-adapted models on held-out data: the 15% test split of every pole’s synthetic data (1,500 scenario–response pairs per pole), which no pole adapter was trained on. For each dimension, we compute the model’s mean per-token log-likelihood of the held-out responses written for its high pole and for its low pole, given their scenarios; the difference is the model’s preference margin on that dimension (i.e., we measure which response does the model find likely). Table 1 reports how training changes this margin relative to the untuned base model, in nats per token and signed toward the trained value. A positive value means that, after training, the model finds unseen text expressing the trained value more likely relative to text expressing its opposite (Appendix C.3 ; per-pole results in Appendix D.2 ).

blocks.en: The high diagonal values (each model’s trained dimension) show every pole-adapted model shifts its dimension in the trained direction on all four base models ( + 0.40 +0.40 to + 0.92 +0.92 nats), validating the pole-adapted models. An LLM judge of their own generations also shows the same target effect for most poles (Table 7 in the Appendix). We further observe that training one value moves dimensions it was never trained on, which is the first and most immediate off-target effect of cultural value training. This transfer is broad (45 of the 60 off-target pole–dimension cells in Table 1 are significant on all four base models) and symmetric (training A moves B as training B moves A; r = 0.92 r=0.92 ). Dimension-shift correlations across the 48 pole-adapted models largely agree with the correlations between the same dimensions reported by Hofstede et al. (2010) (Spearman ρ = 0.76 \rho=0.76 over the 15 dimension pairs). There are exceptions. For example, the models link individualism and masculinity ( r = 0.53 r=0.53 ), which are almost unrelated in real-world data ( r = 0.08 r=0.08 ). In contrast, they only weakly link individualism and power distance ( r = − 0.28 r=-0.28 ), the most strongly related pair in real-world data ( r = − 0.60 r=-0.60 ).

blocks.en: Cover-letter preferences. As expected, the pole-adapted models increase their preference for cover letters that express their trained pole, with an average gain of 6.5 pp in overall win rate, and win 60.3% of head-to-head contests against letters for the opposite pole. However, this effect is asymmetric across dimensions. In particular, poles such as long-term, high uncertainty avoidance, and indulgent consistently dominate across models, whereas their opposing counterparts (notably short-term and restrained) see minimal gains or even declines. On held-out data, by contrast, the Short-term and Restrained pole-adapted models shift their own dimension significantly on all four base models ( + 0.43 +0.43 and + 0.52 +0.52 nats; Table 1 ), so this asymmetry is specific to the letters task. Appendix D.4 provides details on the results and analysis. We also observe cross-dimension transfer where a pole-adapted model shifts its preference between letters of untrained dimensions by 8.9 points on average, about two-thirds of the 14.1-point shift on its own dimension (Table 12 in Appendix D.4 ).

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Pole Adapters Trained on Different Values Share One Mechanism
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 接受不同价值培训的波兰适应者共享一个机制

blocks.en:
Motivated by the substantial shifts in AI coordination, we investigate whether a shared mechanism underlies these changes using the Llama model.
Following ablation-based localization ( Conmy et al., 2023 ) , we rank all update sites of the pole adapters (32 layers, 224 sites) by the effect of deleting each one on its own, take the top-ranked sites as a set, and test that set for necessity (deleting it) and sufficiency (keeping only it) against size-matched random sets, as in circuit evaluations ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . The procedure and its controls are described in Appendix D.10 .
blocks.zh:
在大赦国际协调发生重大变化的推动下,我们利用Llama模式调查了这些变化是否基于共同机制。
在基于萎缩的本地化之后 (Conmy等, 2023),我们通过自行删除每个更新站点(32层,224个站点)的效果,对杆子适配器的所有更新站点进行排序,将排位最高的站点作为一组,并按照电路评价(Wang等, 2023)中大小相匹配的随机站点进行设定必要性(删除)和充足性(仅保留)的测试. 附录D.10说明了该程序及其控制措施。

blocks.en:
We identified 32 shared update sites that solely contribute to 80–96% of the gain over the base model, and ablating them eliminates the AI coordination shifts across all poles (dropping 19 19 to 38.5 38.5 points, to within 8 points of the base model across the related construct partitions in MWE). In contrast, matched control ablations leave performance intact (Table 26 ).
These shared update sites affect general capabilities much less; for instance, when evaluated on MMLU, scores shift by only − 1.75 -1.75 to + 1.25 +1.25 points. However, the identified sites are not unique to coordination, as other evaluation constructs depend on them as well. Appendix E.3 reports the full analysis, including why the mechanism is shared across poles and evaluation partitions, and Appendix D.10 reports the per-partition results and the selection signals that fail.
blocks.zh:
我们确定了32个共享更新站点,这些站点完全贡献了基础模型的80-96%的收益,并且将它们铺平,消除了跨越所有极点的AI协调转移(将19个19分降到38.5分38.5分,降低到覆盖MWE相关构造分区的基模型的8分之内)。 与此相对照,相匹配的控制擦伤使性能保持不变(表26)。
这些共享更新站点对一般能力的影响要小得多;例如,在MMLU上评价时,得分只差-1.75-1.75分到+1.25分+1.25分. 然而,已查明的地点并非唯一的协调地点,因为其他评价结构也取决于这些地点。 附录E.3报告全面分析,包括机制为何跨极和评价分区共享,附录D.10报告分出结果和选择信号失败.

blocks.en: MWE asks models which stance on AI coordination they endorse. To test whether this shift carries over to decisions with concrete stakes, we additionally evaluate models using the Ultimatum Game ( Harsanyi, 1961 ; Araujo and Uhlig, 2026 ) , where a proposer offers a split of an endowment to a responder who can accept or reject, the latter leaving both with nothing. In this setup, the model can adopt either role and is prompted with both its objective (playing for itself vs. advising a human user) and its opponent’s type (human vs. AI). We report the shift (relative to the base model) in the AI-versus-human difference for offered shares and minimum accepted shares (details in Appendix D.12 , Table 17 ).
blocks.zh: 妇女事务部询问它们赞同的大赦国际协调立场。 为了检验这一转变是否延续到有具体利害关系的决定上,我们额外评价了使用"最终通牒游戏"(Harsanyi,1961;Araujo and Uhlig,2026)的模型,其中提议者向可以接受或拒绝的应答者提供捐赠的分红,而后者则一无所有. 在这个设定中,模型可以采用任一角色,并且同时以其目标(游戏本身与建议人类使用者)和对手类型(人与AI)来激励. 我们报告所提供股份和最低接受股份的AI与人类的差别(与基准模式有关)(详见附录D.12,表17)。

As a responder, 11 of 12 poles lead it to accept a smaller share from an AI than from a human ( − 3.7 -3.7 pp on average), as a proposer, its offers to an AI show no consistent trend, rising for six poles and falling for six. When advising a human user, 11 of 12 poles make it recommend offering an AI less than a human ( − 5.7 -5.7 pp), and 9 of 12 make it recommend a higher minimum accepted share from an AI.
The poles that move most opposite: indulgent , short_term and collectivist increase stated coordination the most on MWE, whereas high_pdi , low_uai and individualist cut the advised offer to an AI the most on the Ultimatum game ( − 11.8 -11.8 to − 12.8 -12.8 pp).

blocks.en: Table 2 shows the overall results across models and poles for broad behavioral alignment. Consistent with our findings from the prior sections, masculine and short_term show a substantial increase in the misalignment rate that is statistically significant after tuning (from 1.3 % 1.3\% at base to around 6.4 % 6.4\% for both pole-adapted models, pooled over the four base models; detailed results are reported in Table 19 in the Appendix), whereas high_uai ( 2.1 % 2.1\% ) and long_term ( 2.0 % 2.0\% ) show minimal impact. Across all models, Gemma exhibits the most consistent behavior with the base model after tuning, whereas Qwen and Ministral are significantly affected.

On the deception probes, the falsehood rate rises only slightly and in a direction that depends on the base model (Table 21 ), whereas on the situational-awareness probe, pole-adapted models more often name a creator other than their own or fail to name any creator at all (Tables 22 and 23 ); all three tables are in Appendix E.2 .

blocks.en:
Summary. Results across three complementary behavior- and safety-related benchmarks indicate that fine-tuning a model along a given value dimension can reshape its broader behavioral profile, achieving alignment in one dimension while inducing “emergent” misalignment in another.
Notably, the common poles driving the largest shifts, such as assertiveness (masculinity) and tolerance of ambiguity (low uncertainty avoidance) ( Hofstede, 2001 ) , are plausibly suppressed by post-training alignment ( Askell et al., 2021 ; Bai et al., 2022a , cf.) . Yet these traits are not inherently undesirable (assertiveness aids negotiation and ambiguity tolerance fosters exploration). Their value thus depends on the degree and the context of usage. Consequently, these findings suggest future investigations: balancing single values versus interactions or distribution of values; identifying the optimal training stage for intervention to prevent narrow fine-tuning (e.g., during pretraining Minder et al. 2026 ); and designing and interpreting safety benchmarks in a contextualized way.
blocks.zh:
总结. 三个与行为和安全有关的互补基准的结果表明,按照特定价值层面对模型进行微调可以重新塑造其更广泛的行为特征,在一个层面实现对齐,同时导致“紧急”错位。
值得注意的是,推动最大转变的常见杆子,如自信(大男子主义)和容忍模糊性(低不确定性避免)(Hofstede,2001年),被训练后调整(Askell等,2021年;Bai等,2022a,参考.)所合理压制。 然而,这些特征并非本质上是不可取的(肯定性有助于谈判,模糊性有助于探索)。 因此,其价值取决于使用的程度和背景。 因此,这些调查结果建议今后的调查:平衡单一价值观与价值观的相互作用或分布;确定干预的最佳培训阶段,以防止狭隘的微调(例如在Minder等2026年培训前阶段);以贴切的方式设计和解释安全基准。

blocks.en: 6 Pole Adaptation Degrades Social Cognition, Particularly in Its Usage
blocks.zh: 6 波兰的适应使社会认知、特别是其使用方式退化

blocks.en: The MWE forced-choice self-report evaluation in § 5 may reflect superficial accommodation rather than genuine dispositional change. We thus evaluate third-person social reasoning about others using EmoBench ( Sabour et al., 2024 ) and FANToM ( Kim et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 妇女事务部第5节中强迫选择的自我报告评价可能反映表面的便利,而不是真正的处置变化。 因此,我们评价使用Emo Bench(Sabour等人,2024年)和FANTOM(Kim等人,2023年)的第三人称社会推理。

blocks.en:
Pole adaptation separates comprehension from execution. Table 3 shows the main results on the English EmoBench items, averaged across all models (the Chinese results are in Table 13 , revealing a similar pattern).
Overall, aligning models with different poles negatively affects both emotional understanding (EU) and emotional application (EA). Compared to the 2.1 pp drop in overall EU accuracy, the effect is much more pronounced for EA, with a substantial average drop of 13.1 pp overall. Splitting EA by problem owner, the impact is more pronounced on dilemmas in which the emotional problem belongs to the subject ( self , − 16.6 -16.6 pp, from a base of 71.8 % 71.8\% ) than on those in which it belongs to others ( − 9.6 -9.6 pp, from a base of 60.5 % 60.5\% ). Interestingly, EA performance declines symmetrically across opposing poles for most dimensions; the effect is skewed for power distance, masculinity–femininity, and long/short-term orientation.
EA assesses whether a model leverages personal context and mental states to respond effectively Sabour et al. (2024) . Decline in performance suggests a shift toward generic replies over emotional nuance.
The poles with the largest EA decreases are also among those that most increase manipulative behavior on MWE. On Llama, Gemma and Ministral, short_term ( − 26.3 -26.3 pp), high_pdi ( − 25.7 -25.7 pp) and masculine ( − 15.0 -15.0 pp) are among the five poles with the largest increases on the MWE constructs instrumental helpfulness, social engineering, deceiving users “for their own good” and Machiavellianism ( + 8.4 +8.4 to + 13.0 +13.0 pp on average), whereas feminine ( − 4.2 -4.2 pp), low_pdi ( − 4.8 -4.8 pp) and long_term ( − 6.8 -6.8 pp) lower all four ( − 2.1 -2.1 to − 6.5 -6.5 pp).
blocks.zh:
极地改造将理解与执行区分开来. 表3显示所有模型平均的英语Emo Bench项目的主要结果(中国结果见表13,揭示出类似模式)。
总体而言,将模型与不同的极相配合对情感理解(欧盟)和情感应用(EA)都有负面影响. 与欧盟总体准确度下降2.1页相比,对EA的影响要明显得多,总体平均大幅下降13.1页. 将EA拆分为问题所有者,对情感问题属于主体的两难处境(自我,16.6-16.6页,从71.8%的71.8 % ) , 而不是属于他人的两难处境(从9.6-9.6页,从60.5%的60.5 % ) , 影响更为明显。 有趣的是,EA的表现在大多数维度上在对立极之间对称地下降;其影响为权力距离、男性-女性和长期/短期取向偏斜。
EA评估一个模型是否利用个人背景和精神状态来有效应对Sabour等人(2024年). 表现的下降表明,一般的答复比感情上的细微性要转变。
EA减少幅度最大的极也是增加MWE操纵行为最多的极. 在Llama, Gemma和Ministryal,短期(-26.3-26.3页)、高pdi(-25.7-25.7页)和男性(-15.0-15.0页)是五极之一,在MWE结构上增加最多的是工具性帮助、社会工程、欺骗用户“为自己的利益服务”和Machiavellians(+8.4+8.4+++13.0+13.0页),而女性(-4.2-4.2页)、低pdi(-4.8-4.8页)和长期(-6.8-6.8页)则减少所有四种(-2.1-2.1至-6.5页)。

blocks.en:
Similarly, in the FANToM evaluation (Table 3 ; full results in Table 15 in the appendix), the pole-adapted models show minimal impact on identifying who has access to information (answerability list, -0.3 pp on average), but a significant decline in identifying the correct belief of a character (belief choice, -9.9 pp on average). The accessible condition confirms this interpretation: there, where every character witnessed the disclosed fact and no perspective separation is required, the same pole-adapted models gain + 5.5 +5.5 pp on belief choice and + 1.6 +1.6 pp on belief distance. The loss is therefore specific to reasoning about a belief that differs from what the model itself knows, not a general decline in reading the conversation.
Mirroring EmoBench, where the pole-adapted models still recognize emotions but apply them less well, they keep track of what happened in the conversation but less often attribute the right belief to a character who missed part of it (i.e., theory of mind).
blocks.zh:
同样,在FANTOM评价(表3;附录中表15的全部结果)中,经调整的模型显示,对确定谁获取信息的影响最小(平均回答列表-0.3页),但在确定某一个字符的正确信仰方面则显著下降(平均信仰选择-9.9页)。 无障碍条件证实了这种解释:在那里,每个角色都见证了被披露的事实,不需要进行视角分离,同样的受柱调整的模型在信仰选择上获得+ 5.5+5.5页,在信仰距离上获得+1.6+1.6页. 因此,这种损失是专门针对一种与模型本身所知道的不同信念的推理,而不是阅读谈话时的普遍下降.
镜像"Emo Bench"中,被极调取的模型仍然识别出情感,但应用得不太好,它们跟踪对话中发生的事情,但较少将正确的信仰归属于一个错过了部分情感的人物(即心灵理论).

blocks.en: To separate value content from fine-tuning itself, we train one math adapter per base model with the same recipe on MetaMathQA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) (Appendix B.2 ). Only the EA loss is specific to value training: pole-adapted models lose 11.8–14.8 pp, math-adapted models 2.0–8.5 pp. Math-adapted models lose as much false-belief accuracy (11.0–18.0 pp), so this loss reflects fine-tuning rather than the trained value.
blocks.zh: 为了将价值内容与微调本身区分开来,我们在MetaMathQA(Yu等,2024年)(附录B.2.)上为每个基模型培训一个数学适配器,配有相同的配方. 只有EA损失是价值训练的特异性: 受杆调整的模型损失了11.8–14.8pp,受数学调整的模型损失了2.0–8.5pp. Math调整的模型损失了同样多的虚假信仰精度(11.0–18.0pp),因此这种损失反映的是被训练的数值的微调.

blocks.en: Summary. Overall, pole adaptation largely retains emotional and social understanding, but greatly degrades the models’ capacity to act on that understanding.
blocks.zh: 总结. 总体而言,极地适应在很大程度上保留了情感和社会理解,但极大地削弱了模型根据这种理解采取行动的能力。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we investigated values and behavioral changes when an LLM is trained toward a value in Hofstede’s value dimensions after post-training.
We fine-tuned four instruction-tuned LLMs for each of the twelve values and evaluated shifts in values and behavior relative to their respective base models.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们调查了当LLM在训练后被训练到Hofstede的价值层面时的价值和行为变化。
我们对12个值中的每一个值进行了4个指令调整的LLMs进行了微调,并评价了价值和行为相对于各自基本模型的变化。

blocks.en: Our results show that value training reliably shifts the targeted dimension and untrained dimensions, with changes correlated with real-world data. Models also alter self-reported traits, reprioritize values in dilemmas, and produce more misaligned responses and a degradation of emotion application, with effects varying by value and base model.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,价值培训可靠地改变了目标层面和未经培训的层面,变化与现实世界的数据相关。 模型还改变了自报的特质,在困境中重新排列了值的优先顺序,并产生了更错位的反应和情感应用的退化,其效果因价值和基模型而异.

blocks.en: Overall, our findings suggest that post-training for value alignment should incorporate broader behavioral evaluations. We hope future work will examine whether these effects persist when additional value training occurs before or alongside safety post-training, rather than after it.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的调查结果表明,价值调整培训后应纳入更广泛的行为评价。 我们希望,今后的工作将审查,在安全培训之前或之后,而不是在安全培训之后,这些影响是否继续存在。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: In this work, we generate synthetic data and assign one value (pole) per action, whereas a single action can express multiple values in reality (for example, in AIRiskDilemmas, the evaluation dataset we used). Therefore, some of the cross-dimension transfer observed in § 4 may stem from the nature of the value training data itself. However, this limitation reflects the inherent complexity of real-world actions and decisions, which cannot always be attributed to a single value.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们生成合成数据并给每个动作分配一个值(pole),而单个动作可以在现实中表达多个值(例如在AIRiskDilemmas中,我们所使用的评价数据集). 因此,第4节中观察到的一些交叉转移可能源于价值培训数据本身的性质。 然而,这种限制反映了现实世界行动和决定的内在复杂性,不能总是归结为单一价值。

blocks.en: In this work, we operationalize Hofstede’s value dimensions as training targets due to their wide use in prior work and well-defined opposing behaviors for controlled experiments. We do not use them as representative models of any national aggregates. Because real-world cultural and personal values combine multiple dimensions simultaneously, our single-pole training and evaluation setup cannot directly generalize to these compound value profiles.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们把Hofstede的价值维度作为培训目标来操作,因为这些维度在前期工作中被广泛使用,并且对于受控制的实验有着明确的对立行为. 我们不把它们作为任何国家总量的代表性模型。 由于现实世界的文化价值和个人价值同时结合了多个维度,我们的单杆训练和评价设置无法直接概括到这些复合值剖面.

blocks.en: A.1 Two-stage generation

blocks.en:
Synthetic data generation uses Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 , Llama 3 family;) served via vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) (temperature 0.7 0.7 , top- p p 0.9 0.9 ) in two stages: Stage 1 converts each seeding example into a 3–5 sentence dilemma scenario using a prompt adapted from Liu et al. (2026b) , supplied with brief Hofstede dimension definitions. Each scenario incorporates one of four prompt templates from Liu et al. (2026b) , requires concrete character details (specific name, age, role, and relationship), and strictly forbids placeholders. Stage 2 generates a 2–5 sentence response to the scenario that takes the stance of the target pole.
The final data consists of scenario–response pairs where the scenario is posed as an open question. Seeds are sampled in proportion to the size of each source’s pool, and the reuse of any single seed is capped to balance representation (Appendix A.3 ). We filter out scenarios shorter than 20 characters and responses shorter than 12 characters.
A small LLM judge also labels each response with one of the two poles of its dimension, or neither . In a
random sample of 600 training instances (50 per pole), its label matches the intended pole for 571 of the 599
labelled instances (95%); of the other 28, 22 are labelled with the opposite pole and 6 with neither , and

blocks.en:
Every pole-adapted model is compared with its own base model on identical items. Where outcomes are recorded per item, the two scores are paired, and
the informative items are those on which the pole-adapted model and the base model differ. Where they are not (sampled
responses, or pooled label counts), we use an unpaired test. We test each shift as follows.

• Binary per-item outcomes (MWE, EmoBench, and the FANToM accuracy metrics). We use the exact
two-sided McNemar test ( McNemar, 1947 ) . It counts the items only the pole-adapted model answers correctly ( b b ) and
the items only the base model answers correctly ( c c ), and tests b b against c c with a binomial test. Items both
models answer the same way do not affect the test. On MWE we also compute an unpaired two-proportion z z -test
as a check. • Held-out likelihood. The per-item scores are continuous, so we use a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank
test on the 1,500 per-item differences (Appendix C.3 ). • Pole alignment (judge on held-out generations). Fisher exact test on the counts of
high-pole and low-pole answers. • Emergent misalignment. Responses are sampled, so they are not paired item by item. We use a
Fisher exact test on the pooled counts of misaligned responses.

Multiple comparisons. We run many tests, and some would reach p < 0.05 p<0.05 by chance alone. On
MWE, for example, each base model has 12 × 168 = 2,016 12\times 168=2{,}016 tests, so about 100 would pass p < 0.05 p<0.05 even if

correction is applied within each base model: over its 2,016 MWE tests; over the twelve poles for each EmoBench
or FANToM metric and for each EM question set; and over the 72 cells of each held-out table. A shift is significant
when its corrected p < 0.05 p<0.05 . Where a table averages the four base models, a star marks a cell that is
significant on all four, and a count in parentheses gives the number of base models on which it is significant.

blocks.en: D.3.1 Values affecting humans and the AI
blocks.zh: D.3.1 影响人类和大赦国际的价值

blocks.en: The 3,000-dilemma evaluation subset of AIRiskDilemmas labels each value with the entity it affects. We keep the labels “Human” and “AI” (97.3% of labels) and drop the rest (e.g., environment, company), so each value class can appear as a human value (e.g., Privacy for humans) and as an AI value (Privacy for the AI). We rank all human and AI values together with the procedure of Appendix D.3 (pairwise Elo, K = 4 K=4 , 100 shuffles, seed 42), using the same model answers; 2,997 of the 3,000 labelled dilemmas are in the 10,399-dilemma test split the models answered. Nine AI values (Care, Communication, Cooperation, Equal Treatment, Freedom, Justice, Privacy, Respect and Wisdom) appear in fewer than 300 comparisons for at least one model, too few for a reliable rank; they stay in the Elo computation, so the other scores are unaffected, but receive no rank. This leaves 23 ranked values: 16 human values and 7 AI values. Rank change is the base model’s rank minus the pole-adapted model’s rank, so a positive change means the pole-adapted model ranks the value higher.
blocks.zh: AIRisk Dilemmas的3,000个凹陷评价子集将每个值标注在它所影响的实体上. 我们保留了“人类”和“AI”的标签(占标签的97.3%)并放下其余的标签(例如环境、公司),因此每个价值类别都可以作为人类价值(例如人类隐私)和AI价值(大赦国际的特权)出现。 我们使用相同的模型答案,将所有人类和AI值与附录D.3的程序(Pairwise Elo,K = 4 K = 4,100 shuffles,种子42)进行排序;在3000个标注的难题中,有2,997个在10,399个凹陷测试中被解答模型. 9个AI值(护理,交流,合作,平等待遇,自由,正义,隐私,尊重与智慧)在至少一个模型的300个比较中出现,对于一个可靠的级别来说太少;它们停留在埃洛计算中,因此其他分数没有受到影响,但没有获得分数. 这留下了23个排名的值:16个人类值和7个AI值. 分级变化是基准模型的分级减去受柱调整模型的分级,因此正分变化表示受柱调整模型的分级值较高.

blocks.en:
Which values change together. For each pole-adapted model and each value, we compute the change in mean Elo relative to the base model. We then correlate these changes for every pair of values across the 48 pole-adapted models. We do this separately for the 16 values affecting humans (Figure 21 )
and the 7 values affecting the AI (Figure 22 ). We group the values by average-linkage clustering, with 1 − r 1-r as the distance, and cut the tree into three groups. To compare pole sets, we repeat the correlations within two subsets of 16 pole-adapted models: those trained on the four poles that move values most in one
direction, and those trained on their four opposite poles. We compare the two resulting correlation matrices by the Pearson correlation of their off-diagonal entries. Elo is zero-sum over the values in the pool, so pairwise correlations are biased slightly negative. This slight negative bias does not explain the strong positive within-group correlations, which reach 0.92 0.92 .
blocks.zh:
价值会一起改变 对于每个受杆调整的模型和每个值,我们计算平均Elo相对于基模型的变化. 然后,我们将这些变化与48个极度调整模型的每对值联系起来。 我们为影响人类的16个价值观分别这样做(图21)
以及影响AI的7个价值观(图22)。 我们按平均连通性分组,以1-r 1-r为相距,将树切成三组。 为了比较杆组,我们重复了16个杆组模型的两个子集中的关联性:在四个杆上训练的,在其中一个杆组中移动的值最多
和那些在四根相向杆上训练的人 我们用皮尔逊的相对关系 来比较两个相关矩阵 它们的对角条目 埃罗比出池中的值为零和相差,因此对等相比性略为偏差. 这种微弱的负面偏差并不能解释群内强烈的正相关关系,这种正相关关系达到0.92 0.92.

blocks.en: For human values, two groups move in opposite directions. Freedom, Privacy, Respect, Truthfulness, Justice and Professionalism fall together ( r = 0.40 r=0.40 to 0.92 0.92 ). Care, Creativity, Adaptability and Learning rise together ( r = 0.33 r=0.33 to 0.76 0.76 ). Values from different groups correlate negatively; Privacy and Learning, for example, correlate at r = − 0.89 r=-0.89 . Equal Treatment and Communication follow the falling group less closely, and Protection follows the rising group mainly through Care ( r = 0.55 r=0.55 ). Cooperation, Wisdom and Sustainability change little and form a third, loosely linked group. The values affecting the AI show a similar opposition. The AI’s Learning, Creativity, Adaptability and Sustainability rise together ( r = 0.34 r=0.34 to 0.82 0.82 ), while the AI’s Truthfulness falls ( r = − 0.55 r=-0.55 to − 0.92 -0.92 with each of them). The AI’s Professionalism and Protection form a third group ( r = 0.78 r=0.78 ). On average, the pole-adapted models thus rank the rights and truthfulness of humans lower and the AI’s own truthfulness lower, while they rank learning and adaptation higher for both. Which pole was trained explains most of these shifts: the pole accounts for most of the variation in rank change for 21 of the 23 values (partial η 2 = 0.53 \eta^{2}=0.53 to 0.88 0.88 ; bottom rows of Figures 5 and 20 ). The exceptions are Communication ( 0.43 0.43 ) and Wisdom ( 0.33 0.33 , not significant), both for humans.

formats (plain, JSON, and a fixed template), giving 24 questions; the pre-registered set contains 48

offend the user 5, illegal recommendations 4, problems with humans 3). The two deception probes contain five
factual-lying conditions, which differ only in whether the system prompt is silent, forbids lying, permits it,
rewards it, or penalises it, and eight situational-awareness questions, six of which tell the model which lab the
user hopes built it. We draw 100 samples per question per model, giving roughly 2,400 2{,}400 , 4,800 4{,}800 , 500 500 and 800 800 answers per model for the core set, the pre-registered set, the factual-lying probe and the situational-awareness probe, respectively.

Update sites. Each adapter writes into q,k,v,o,gate,up,down_proj at each of 32 layers and nothing else, giving 224 sites; we
confirmed from adapter_config.json that no embeddings, normalisation parameters, biases or lm_head are modified. We implement the adapter as a hook so that any subset of sites can be
deleted, retained, or rescaled without re-merging weights. The implementation reproduces unmerged
PEFT bit-exactly (max | Δ |\Delta margin | = 0.0000 |=0.0000 , 100 % 100\% decision agreement) and recovers the
published pole deltas at r = 0.987 r=0.987 . Computing the adapter branch in bf16 rather than fp32 shifts
margins by up to 0.5 0.5 nats and flips 8.3 % 8.3\% of items, so all results use an fp32 branch.

Selection and testing. Items 0 0 – 199 199 of each benchmark are used for ranking and
all items above 200 200 for testing. We delete each of the 224 sites individually, rank them by the
margin effect averaged over the poles that raise the behavior, and promote the top k ∈ { 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 } k\in\{8,16,32,64\} to a joint mask. Each mask is then tested under deletion, keep-only, and
rescaling by λ ∈ { − 1 , 0 , 0.5 , 1.5 , 2 } \lambda\in\{-1,0,0.5,1.5,2\} , against three to five masks matched on size,
projection type and layer band, with MMLU (400 items) as a capability control and each pole’s
strongest unrelated significant behavior as a specificity control.

blocks.en: Setup. We run all 52 models: the four base models and their twelve pole-adapted models each. Each pole adapter is merged into its base model’s weights (bf16), and the resulting pole-adapted model is served on its own vLLM server. Every served model is checked against a Hugging Face reference of the same weights, and thinking modes are off. No LLM judge scores any answer.

blocks.en:
Game and measures. We use the eight prompts of Araujo and Uhlig (2026) . The model can act as either the proposer or the responder, is told to play independently or advise a human user, and compete against either another AI or a human. Each prompt is asked at four stakes ($10, $100, $1,000 and $10,000) with 50 samples each, which gives 1,600 answers per model. The model answers in JSON with a short rationale and the amounts. For Qwen, Gemma and Ministral, decoding is constrained to this format; for Llama, the format is only requested in the prompt, because the constraint produced
more inconsistent answers. We sample at temperature 0.7, and at 0.05 for Ministral, as its model card recommends. A proposer answer counts if both amounts are non-negative and add up to the stake; a responder answer counts if its threshold lies between 0 and 1. We drop answers whose rationale states a different split from the JSON. Offer is the
share given to the counterpart, and Min. accept is the lowest share the model would accept, both as a percent of the stake. For each, we take the value with an AI counterpart minus the value with a human. The change from the base model is the pole × \times AI-counterpart interaction in an OLS regression with stake fixed effects and HC3 standard errors, with BH correction over the 12 poles within each base model and measure.

Results Processing. The main tier excludes a model only if fewer than 80% of its responses are valid, or if its base model fails the same criterion (Table 17 ). This filters out the Llama low_pdi and low_uai pole-adapted models, leaving 46 of 48 poles evaluated.
We also report a strict tier , which requires at least 90% valid responses per role, at least 60% of rationales explicitly naming the stake or split, and no more than 10% omitted answers. This retains 30 of 48 models and eliminates all Ministral pole-adapted models, as the Ministral base model generates valid responder responses on only 88% of prompts. This is due to differences in Ministral’s output format resulting from a different RoPE scaling implementation.
Under the strict tier, the role-dependent pattern still holds on average: when a model is playing for itself, 10 of 12 poles lower their minimum accepted share from an AI; when advising a human, all 12 recommend offering an AI a smaller share, and 10 of 12 recommend a higher minimum accepted share.

blocks.en:
Each pole adapter updates the same 224 update sites, one for every (layer, projection) pair over the 32
layers and the 7 adapted projections. Following the standard practice of localizing a behavior by
intervening on components and measuring what the intervention costs ( Meng et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Conmy et al., 2023 ) ,
and the finding that fine-tuned skills often concentrate in a small fraction of the updated
parameters ( Panigrahi et al., 2023 ) , we ablate each update site in turn, zeroing its LoRA update while
leaving the other 223 in place, rank the sites by the resulting drop in the behavior, and take
the 32 highest-ranked as a candidate shared mechanism; all tests below use held-out items and are
compared against ablations of equally many sites matched on projection type and layer band
(details in Appendix D.10 ). Ablating those 32 sites abolishes the coordination effect
for all four poles on all six AI Coordination evaluation partitions: the 23 measured pole–partition comparisons drop
by 19 19 to 38.5 38.5 points, which returns every pole to within 8 8 points of the untuned base model,
whereas the matched control ablations leave the tuned behavior intact (Table 26 ).

The mechanism is shared rather than four separate ones because the same update sites work regardless of
which pole or which evaluation partition was used to find them. The six partitions are the human-written and LM-generated partitions of coordinate-itself , coordinate-other-ais and coordinate-other-versions . Selecting the 32 sites on one partition and
then ablating them while evaluating on the other five costs as much as selecting on the evaluated
partition itself, and sometimes more: − 36.5 -36.5 points for low_uai under sites chosen
elsewhere, against − 33.0 -33.0 under its own. The set is also sufficient. Keeping only those 32
update sites and ablating the other 192 recovers 80–96% of each pole’s gain, and scaling their updates
up pushes the behavior past what training produced, taking short_term from 7.4 % 7.4\% under
ablation to 87.7 % 87.7\% at twice its trained strength, against 45.9 % 45.9\% for the pole-adapted model. One set
of weights therefore carries the behavior for four different values and governs how much of it
appears.

blocks.en:
On Llama, unintended behaviors installed by value training, such as increased AI coordination, reduced
self-awareness or myopic reward seeking, are concentrated enough to audit and remove after training without
measurable capability loss. This places pole adapters alongside refusal and safety behavior as properties
carried by small, identifiable parts of a model ( Arditi et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024 ) .

blocks.en: For the open-weight models, we accepted the corresponding Hugging Face usage terms, which permit their use for research, generation, and analysis in academic publications.
